column1: # docs/globals-ledger.tsv -- one row per piece of STATIC STORAGE STATE on the
# server link line, and what is to become of it. plan_globals.md step G0.
# A row exists for every mutable symbol `tools/globals-census` finds, and
# `globals-census gate` fails in BOTH directions: a symbol with no row, and a
# row whose symbol is no longer there. A keep-list nobody re-derives rots
# silently -- a row naming something deleted three phases ago still reads as a
# claim -- and that exact failure was caught at a merge on this project.
# THE KEY IS (home, mangled).
#   home     the OBJECT file, for a LOCAL symbol. Two translation units'
#            `static int s_n;` are two distinct pieces of state and get two
#            rows. EMPTY for a GLOBAL/WEAK/UNIQUE symbol, which the linker
#            folds into one piece of state however many objects emit it.
#   mangled  the symbol table's own name. NOT the demangled one: studio.o
#            holds two distinct statics that both demangle to
#            `CStudioHdr::GroupStudioHdr(int)::__executeCount`, and keyed on
#            the readable name they collapse into one row, the link level
#            reads 468 instead of 469, and the gate reports the survivor as an
#            orphan. `name` is carried beside it so the file reads; nothing
#            joins on it.
# THE DISPOSITIONS. plan_globals.md 1's six, plus one admission.
#   DEAD     no live reader. Delete.
#   CONST    written only by its initialiser; becomes .rodata, no static-init.
#   MANAGED  game state or policy with no reason to be native; becomes an
#            INSTANCE FIELD reachable from the managed ServerGameDll -- never a
#            C# `static`, which would only move the problem across the boundary.
#   MEMBER   must stay native; becomes a member of a subsystem object owned by
#            CShellGameDll, with a lifetime tier (DLL or LEVEL).
#   FLOOR    the engine or a static library reaches it BY SYMBOL, or it IS
#            static-init registration. Stays. The ledger names who reads it.
#   GONE     it leaves with its file under a plan_shim ruling already made.
#   UNRULED  nobody has ruled it yet. Not a disposition -- an admission. The
#            row exists so the gate's membership check passes; the count is
#            capped in docs/globals-ratchet.tsv and is the number this plan
#            exists to drive to zero, the same shape as `shim_reason_none`.
# GONE IS EXPECTED TO STAY AT ZERO, and that is a finding rather than an
# oversight. 332 of the old 619-row table were GONE, meaning "this leaves under
# a plan_shim phase that has not run yet". All six of those phases have now
# run. There is no phase left for a row to leave under, so everything still on
# the link line is here until this plan removes it, and a row cannot be
# dismissed by pointing at somebody else's step.
# HOW IT IS MAINTAINED -- RECONCILE, NEVER REGENERATE.
#     tools/globals-census reseed            # report what would change
#     tools/globals-census reseed --write    # apply it
# reseed carries every existing ruling forward UNTOUCHED, adds a row for each
# new symbol, and prunes rows whose symbol is gone. It does not re-derive a row
# a human has ruled. Regenerating this file from the census would overwrite the
# triage with the raw schema, which is the failure the `scan-guards --tsv is not
# the ledger` note on this project records.
# WHAT THE TOOL MAY DERIVE, AND WHAT IT MUST NOT. Two rules fire, and each is a
# fact the tree states rather than a reading of intent:
#   DEAD    the linker DROPPED it -- nothing in the shipped .so reads it. The
#           strongest 0-consumer proof available, and re-derivable at any tip.
#   FLOOR   it is the DLL instance whose address EXPOSE_SINGLE_INTERFACE_GLOBALVAR
#           takes at static init, or one of the two stock chains the engine
#           walks, or a static inside a vendor header under public/steam/, or
#           the compiler's own unwinder reference.
#           An `__g_Create*_reg` InterfaceReg node is NOT derived FLOOR. It
#           registers a STRING, and whether anything resolves that string is a
#           question its existence does not answer -- the 619-row ruling table
#           ruled 2 of these 11 DEAD for exactly that reason. They are UNRULED
#           with the check written in the row.
# Everything else is UNRULED. MEMBER, MANAGED and CONST each need somebody to
# read the code and name a consumer or a managed home; a tool that guessed them
# would produce a ledger nobody had read row by row.
# MEASURED 2026-09-21 at 85e21958b, server/debug, 108 objects on the link line:
#   link level 469 = DEAD 33 + FLOOR 12 + UNRULED 424.
# The FLOOR 12 is 8 Steam SDK accessor cells + s_gameShellDll +
# g_pServerClassHead + s_pNonModifiedPointerProxyHead +
# DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0. plan_globals.md 2's target floor is 22, and 12
# is BELOW it -- which is not progress, it is the 424 unread rows, some of
# which will be FLOOR. The 11 InterfaceReg nodes are among them.
